scripts.dev: npm run build -w @spendio/shared && npm run dev -w @spendio/web
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @spendio/shared && npm run dev -w @spendio/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @spendio/shared && npm run dev -w @spendio/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @spendio/shared && npm run build -w @spendio/api && npm run build -w @spendio/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @spendio/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: npm run build -w @spendio/shared && npm run test:unit -w @spendio/api
